headline: First public week for MGAT Alpha v3.1: the system launched mid-week and closed 6 trades, all losses, for -$86.98 (0% win rate) against an $8,000 paper book. Measured-beta share on new positions was 68.75% (11 of 16 opens). Because the system's first cycle falls inside this week, no equity reading exists from before the week started, so return-on-book (%) isn't computable this week. The sample (6 of a 200-trade target) is far too small to call the logic healthy or broken. Note: the regime feed reports a fourth state, NEUTRAL, alongside RISK_ON/RISK_OFF/UNKNOWN -- carried below as its own count rather than folded into another bucket.
llm_adviser: The run log shows llm_mode: 'active' for this week's run-starts -- UNCONFIRMED whether this reflects the intended adviser switch (agreed state: OFF) or an unrelated runtime flag; verify against source before trusting either reading. In practice the adviser acted as a pure observer this week: 16 observations logged, zero effect on trades.
sample_caveat: 6 trades closed this week, 6 all-time against the 200-trade target -- far too small a sample for win rate or PnL% to be a meaningful read; directional at best.
paper_caveat: Alpha is paper -- simulated fills, no slippage, no thin-liquidity exits, no can't-sell-into-dust. A clean logic result here is never a claim that the execution floor works; that claim belongs to the Beta rung alone.
integrity: No CLASS-A changes landed this week -- clean comparison. Two operational repairs and one install-layer guard were logged at launch, none of which touched trading logic, exposure, beta derivation, the ledger, or the paper engine.

verdict.text: Six closed trades, all losses, is too small a sample to call the logic healthy or broken -- the 200-trade target puts this week at 3% of the way there. Measured-beta share for the week's opens was 68.75%, reasonably high, so sizing mostly reflects real correlations rather than stand-in weights. The counterfactual book hasn't closed a single trade yet, so a primary-vs-counterfactual comparison isn't possible yet. Two critical alarms fired at launch (a cold price feed left the regime signal and the beta benchmark blind) and have not recurred since.
